message: dependency cycle: apps/mobile/src, apps/mobile/src/components, apps/mobile/src/composables, apps/mobile/src/views
apps/mobile/src/components (layer presentation) -> apps/mobile/src (layer app-shell) (import) points up the layer order
apps/mobile/src/composables (layer state) -> apps/mobile/src/components (layer presentation) (import) points up the layer order
apps/mobile/src/utils (layer utils) -> apps/mobile/src/services (layer services) (import+type-import) points up the layer order
